body: the description here is for `showParentLevel`, but the item is `showMoreLimit`

I has to rename the `RefinementListItem` type to `TRefinementListItem` since there is already the `RefinementListItem` component in this file. I did not rename the `HierarchicalMenuItem` type since there is no name conflict with it. I can apply the same naming to it to be more coherent.

There is an issue in TypeScript, when you try to iterate on an array with an union type you get the error "This expression is not callable." https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/36390

You have to manually cast it to avoid the error (https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/36390#issuecomment-641718624)

According to this https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/commit/b217f22e798c781f55d17da72ed099a9dee5c650 it should be fixed in v4.2.3 but we are using the v4.1.5 in the project.
